description.zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用 API 请求的 RequestId 作为 ClientToken 标识。每次 API 请求的 RequestId 可能不一样。
description.en:
Ensures the idempotency of the request. Generate a unique parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request.

description.zh: 注册者证件号码。长度不超过50字符。
description.en: The document number of the registrant. Maximum length: 50 characters.

description.zh: 注册者证件图片(base64)。原文件大小为 50KB-3MB。
description.en: The document image of the registrant (Base64-encoded). The original file size must be between 50 KB and 3 MB.

description.zh: 注册者证件类型。详见附录证件类型。
description.en: The document type of the registrant. For more information, see the appendix on document types.

description.zh: 电子邮箱。长度不超过 300 字符。
description.en: The email address. Maximum length: 300 characters.

description.zh: 注册者名称。长度不超过 255 字符。
description.en: The name of the registrant. Maximum length: 255 characters.

description.zh: 注册者联系电话。长度不超过 128 字符。所属国家是中国的，非手机号码区号需与所在市匹配。
description.en: The phone number of the registrant. Maximum length: 128 characters. If the country is China, the area code of a non-mobile phone number must match the city.
The ID of the registrant profile.
